title: Introduction to Agentic Coding
description: Learn how AI coding agents go beyond suggestions — planning, executing multi-step tasks, and building features autonomously with human oversight.

data.text: Unlike standard chat or autocomplete, an agentic workflow involves a continuous loop: Planning, Executing, and Verifying. The AI agent analyzes the goal, proposes a series of file changes, executes them, and reads the compiler or test output to verify if the changes were successful.

data.title: Human in the Loop
data.text: While agents operate autonomously, the developer's role shifts from writing code to reviewing plans and guiding the agent when it gets stuck.
